2608.12842.title: CABS+: Efficient and Scalable Model Merging via Conflict-Aware Sparsification and Adaptive Weight Allocation
2608.12842.paper_summary: Model merging has recently attracted significant attention as a promising paradigm for constructing unified multi-task models without requiring additional retraining. However, parameter conflicts and knowledge interference across tasks often degrade merged-model performance. Prior work introduced Conflict-Aware and Balanced Sparsification (CABS), which reduces parameter interference through structured pruning and sequential masking. However, CABS relies on grid search to determine scaling coefficients, resulting in exponential time complexity, while its optimization objective can be dominated by high-performance tasks, leading to suboptimal overall performance. To address these limitations, we extend CABS and propose CABS+. Specifically, Adaptive Weight Allocation (AWA) optimizes merging coefficients via a gradient-free search scheme to reduce time complexity, while an asymmetric fitness function promotes more comprehensive performance gains across tasks. Moreover, we conduct a systematic empirical study of key factors influencing model merging performance and propose Relative Synergy Score (RSS) to quantify model mergeability and guide model selection. We compare CABS+ with state-of-the-art model merging methods, including CABS, AdaMerging, and WUDIMerging, across 27 datasets and 5 models covering large language, small-scale language, and vision models. Extensive experiments verify the effectiveness and efficiency of CABS+. Compared with AdaMerging and WUDIMerging, CABS+ improves overall performance by 16.97% and 12.93%, respectively, exhibits stronger stability and robustness across varying task numbers and model architectures, uses less than 25% of the GPU memory required by AdaMerging, and achieves nearly a 4x speedup in merging time over WUDIMerging.
2608.12842.paper_summary_zh: 模型合併最近引起了相當大的關注，作為一種有前景的範式，用於構建統一的多任務模型，而無需額外的再訓練。<lb/>然而，任務之間的參數衝突和知識干擾往往會降低合併模型的性能。<lb/>先前的研究引入了衝突感知和平衡稀疏化（CABS），通過結構化修剪和序列掩蔽來減少參數干擾。<lb/>然而，CABS依賴網格搜索來確定縮放系數，這導致指數級的時間複雜度，而其優化目標可能會被高性能任務主導，從而導致整體性能不佳。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們擴展了CABS並提出了CABS+。<lb/>具體而言，自適應權重分配（AWA）通過無梯度搜索方案優化合併系數，以降低時間複雜度，而不對稱的適應度函數促進了跨任務的更全面的性能增益。<lb/>此外，我們對影響模型合併性能的關鍵因素進行了系統的實證研究，並提出了相對協同得分（RSS）來量化模型的可合併性並指導模型選擇。<lb/>我們將CABS+與最先進的模型合併方法進行比較，包括CABS、AdaMerging和WUDIMerging，涵蓋27個數據集和5個模型，涉及大型語言、小型語言和視覺模型。<lb/>大量實驗驗證了CABS+的有效性和效率。<lb/>與AdaMerging和WUDIMerging相比，CABS+分別提高了整體性能16.97%和12.93%，在不同任務數量和模型架構中展現出更強的穩定性和魯棒性，使用的GPU內存少於AdaMerging所需的25%，並且在合併時間上實現了接近4倍的加速，相較於WUDIMerging。
